On each branch normalized contact points admit explicit nonnegative weights with mean 0 and covariance I/2. Weighted containment inequalities for any competing translated or rotated ellipse force its singular-value product to be at least one; equality forces the same ellipse. Exact differentiations give both nonzero second-derivative jumps. The included checker passed 54,394 finite diagnostics from its actual path; these are ancillary.

value.rationale: A natural one-parameter family of convex shapes is completely classified under the unrestricted minimum enclosing-ellipse problem, despite continuous curved boundaries. The nontrivial four-point reduction, changes from three to four and back to three active contacts, and exact C1/not-C2 transitions support ongoing convex-geometric optimization and benchmarking beyond already known individual half-disk and 120-degree sector instances.
